scope: Editor decoration, phrase, frame and layout picker completion guards after async access checks. Preserved the completed reader/controller and home shelf fixes.

environment.policy: The previous heartbeat records already require avoiding new compiler/test work below 2 GiB free. No new test/compiler process was launched. Did not delete other work, shared build caches or user files. Low storage was previously reported; do not repeat an unchanged disk warning as a new product failure.

verified_existing_guards: Frame picker acquires _isApplying before awaiting access; it rejects disposed, finishing or non-current routes before committing and uses _finishing to prevent duplicate close/pop.
Phrase picker serializes access with _isApplying and checks mounted/current route before invoking its callback.
Decoration picker serializes an outstanding insertion with _isApplying and checks its owning State remains mounted after awaiting access.

The default point-shop gate checks the captured route remains current and the repository account remains unchanged after server access, purchase, top-up and receipt boundaries. Existing gating is not bypassed or weakened.
Existing editor_point_shop_gate_test fixtures cover cancelled approval, duplicate taps, positive approval and widget disposal; they were reviewed but not rerun this heartbeat.
Layout selection callbacks are synchronous; no delayed transport or image decoding job is started by PageTemplatePicker itself.

next_controlled_candidate.observation: Decoration insertion awaits access, then DecoratePanel looks up the then-current editor notifier/page when its callback runs. The portrait modal captures session/page identity for the rearrangement branch, but decoration does not currently use that capture. Route/account checks alone do not establish editor page/session identity.
next_controlled_candidate.not_a_confirmed_user_bug: A reproducible user path with a still-mounted/current decoration panel, approved access and a changed editor page/session has not been demonstrated. Do not claim that normal tapping changes the wrong album, and do not add an unverified guard that breaks valid inline panel reuse.
next_controlled_candidate.next_step: After storage recovers, use a delayed pointShopAccessGateProvider fixture to change the editor session/page before approval; verify cancellation, preserved valid same-target application, and intentional inline page changes separately. Compare with the existing layer target guard and photo-import lifecycle guards.

validation.reason: Insufficient host storage for safe compiler/test execution; this is a read-only source review, not a fresh passing regression result.

next: Check free disk and test-asset availability before any compiler invocation; require at least the existing 2 GiB minimum resource guard.
Reproduce the editor target-identity candidate before editing; preserve current access/pricing/ownership and inline panel behavior.
Continue main/store/reader hidden-resume and stale-owner review only where newer evidence exists.

limits: No fresh functional test or static-analysis result is claimed for this heartbeat. Previous verified test counts remain attached to their earlier reports only.
No physical-device FPS, app heap, peak process memory or native leak measurement was performed.
Host disk exhaustion is not attributed to the app or to one particular task.
notification_decision: DONT_NOTIFY: no confirmed new product issue, no production change, and no new user action beyond the already known host-storage limitation.
